mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific trigger conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% triggers aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1350 thousand units and unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals dual economic deterioration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST < 1350 and UNRATE > 4.5% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) triggers accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through improved consumer spending and corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 0) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days without trigger conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1300 thousand units signals residential sector contraction, reducing household wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 102) and rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.2%) indicates supply shock coupled with monetary tightening, reducing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 102 and FEDFUNDS > 4.2% fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals persistent supply-side contraction, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days during supply shock regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
